Visit note | 2025-05-10 10:00 AM | Dr. Farhana Kabir, General Medicine | Patient: Shikha Dey, 31, female. Ms. Dey attends for a routine review and reports she has been looking quite pale lately and gets breathless when walking up the stairs. She works as a hotel receptionist and mentions these signs started after a stomach illness during a stay in Chattogram. She has Type 2 diabetes mellitus and takes her medications regularly without chest discomfort or palpitations. On examination: haemoglobin 7.9 g/dL, BP 127/82 mmHg, pulse 92 bpm, weight 57 kg. Conjunctivae are pale, and chest examination is clear. Assessment: Iron deficiency anaemia. Plan: chronic follow-up: continue current medicines, no new prescription issued today. She was advised to eat more lentils, spinach, liver, and eggs, and to avoid tea within an hour of meals. Follow-up in 6 weeks with a repeat haemoglobin.

Visit note | 2025-05-10 11:00 AM | Dr. Zahid Hasan, Gastroenterology | Patient: Farzana Hossain, 46, female. Plan: referral to General Medicine in this clinic for further assessment; no new prescription issued. She was advised to eat regular meals, keep a food diary, and reduce tea, fizzy drinks, and beans. Follow-up after the General Medicine review.
